name: Portal Match
office_task: Each weekday, check every job's status in Simpro against the client's work-order portal by work-order number, show each difference with both values, and fix one only once a person accepts it.
systems_of_record: Simpro (the job carries the client's work-order number; owns the job status and the invoiced total)
the client's work-order portal: a real estate agency's maintenance system, a facilities manager or a CMMS (issues the work-order number; owns the attend-by date and the not-to-exceed limit)

emits.write: the run's work-order report where the service coordinator opens it: the pair contract it ran under, the key it joined on (work_order_no), the owner per field, and the counts matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned and corrected, published every run including the all-clear
emits.readback: the report store returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the contract id, the five counts and the published time; no id back means the run did not publish and the owner is told

emits.write: an accepted correction on the Simpro job, one field (the attend-by date or the not-to-exceed limit the portal owns), with the difference id and the name of the person who accepted it, and both original values kept on the difference
emits.readback: Simpro returns the job id for the write, and reading the job back returns the accepted value on that field; no id back raises portal_match.write_not_read_back and the person keys it by hand

emits.write: an exception on the work order naming the person who owns it: an open difference with the Simpro value, the portal value and the owning system's value side by side awaiting acceptance, a work order on one side only, a gap over the threshold amount, a run over the mismatch rate, or an accepted correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the work_order_no, the field, both values and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
